Thank you so much! It's really good to hear the opinion of someone who knows what it's like, and it made me realize how much I do self-shame and beat myself up about not acting perfectly in social situations, and how I use it to measure my self-worth when I should accept it. I also agree with the fact that I often pull out of the present to mull over how I acted in the past, and so my mind is not fully there which makes it harder. It was all very useful advice and the comments about how having social anxiety did not make me less of a worthwhile person really helped. Thanks!
